welcome.title: Welcome to TranscriptPRO
welcome.subtitle: A desktop subtitle editor with local AI transcription. Let's get you set up in a few quick steps.

model.title: Choose a Whisper model
model.subtitle: Whisper runs entirely on your device — no internet required for transcription.
model.skipHint: You can download a model any time from the transcription panel. Transcription won't work until one is installed.

apiKeys.title: API keys (optional)
apiKeys.subtitle: Add keys for cloud translation (Gemini/Claude) — or skip and use the free offline model (TranslateGemma, one-time download) from the Translation panel. You can add keys later in Settings.

done.title: All set!
done.tip: Tip: drag a video or audio file onto the window to open it instantly.
done.settingsHint: All settings can be changed later in the Settings panel.
